svg.aria-label: Update, Pipesmith Registry 0.2.1. update checks signature, version and schema before it swaps two links; when the new server fails, the links and copies go back. 1: update to Install root: lock the root; read update.json and current. 2: update to Release folder: signature of SHA256SUMS, SHA-256 of the binary. 3: update to Release folder: copy answers version: higher than current. 4: update to Data directory: schema plan; free space for the copies. 5: update to Install root: releases/<version>/; previous -> old, current -> new. 6: update to systemd unit: systemctl restart. 7: systemd unit to New server: start. 8: New server to Data directory: copy state.sqlite.v1, then migrate. 9: update to New server: GET /api/health and /api/status, 30 s. Way back when the restart or the health wait fails. 10: update to Install root: current and previous as they were. 11: update to systemd unit: systemctl stop. 12: update to Data directory: state.sqlite.v1 back; migrated file kept as .failed. 13: update to systemd unit: restart the earlier release, health wait, exit 1.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry update
